source.text: A case with one fault: a fuel limit conditioned on a cladding band whose upper end is below its lower end, so it would never be in force. FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_OUT_OF_RANGE.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/limits-condition-never-holds.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
